# Type <a class="source-link ignore-header" href="https://github.com/example/Sample/blob/main/src/Type.luau#L1" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="View source"></a>

Shared aliases, and the only module that names Roblox classes: the `New<>`
arms below are what `linkRobloxTypes` resolves against, so engine linking is
covered in one place instead of leaking into every other fixture module.

<!-- #region types -->

### `Constructor` <Badge type="info" text="type" /> <a class="source-link ignore-header" href="https://github.com/example/Sample/blob/main/src/Type.luau#L15" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="View source"></a>

```luau luaudocs-links=[[19,22,"/api/Type#new"],[32,37,"https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Frame"],[41,44,"/api/Type#new"],[53,61,"https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance"]]

One arm per resolvable form: a string-literal class name, and the `string`
fallback whose class is named as a plain identifier.
